mapper.select: SELECT id, name, brand, specification, origin, rating, remarks, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted FROM price_products WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY updated_at DESC
SELECT id, name, brand, specification, origin, rating, remarks, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted FROM price_products WHERE brand = #{brand} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY updated_at DESC
SELECT id, name, brand, specification, origin, rating, remarks, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted FROM price_products WHERE rating = #{rating} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY updated_at DESC
